_comment: Example shape for scripts/upsert-watchlists.js. Copy this file to data/watchlists.json and edit. Accepts top-level array form OR { watchlists: [...] } form (both equivalent).

watchlists._note: Numeric-prefix ASX tickers like ASX:29M, ASX:360, ASX:5GG are sometimes rejected by TradingView. They will land in the report's rejected_symbols array without aborting the batch.
